title: Skeleton-based Activity Recognition
summary: Faculty-supervised research on recognizing human activity from Kinect skeleton keypoints, evaluated on NTU RGB+D (60 actions).

caseStudy.problem: Raw Kinect skeletons are noisy. Solo actions often contain a spurious second body, and some frames have sensor artifacts.
caseStudy.decision: Built a denoise, normalize and resample pipeline first, then grew the model one step at a time (position, velocity, two actors, bone vectors, then a CNN with a bidirectional GRU and frame attention), comparing every step against the same baseline.
caseStudy.broke: Some shoulder-to-spine distances were zero, which blew up the normalization. A floor on the scale fixed it, and I reprocessed the whole dataset.
caseStudy.result: 74.0% cross-subject and 83.8% cross-view accuracy on NTU RGB+D.

title: Diabetes Risk Predictor
summary: A diabetes risk model trained on CDC BRFSS 2024 survey data, shipped as a live web app with a FastAPI backend and React frontend.

caseStudy.problem: Diabetes cases are the minority class, so a plain classifier looks accurate while missing the people it should flag.
caseStudy.decision: Weighted the positive class, tuned with randomized search, and set the decision threshold to 0.40 to favor recall over precision.
caseStudy.result: Took it past the notebook into a deployed app anyone can try.
